Describe how the 3D viewing transformation uses camera parameters to define a view coordinate system and transform world coordinates into view coordinates.
Explain projection transformation, including perspective and parallel projection, view volume and canonical view volume, and the matrix steps used to project points onto the view plane.
Describe how the window-to-viewport transformation maps a projected point from an abstract window to a device-specific viewport.
Explain how clipping and hidden surface removal discard unnecessary geometry before projection and reduce rendering computation.
Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next pipeline stage.
